_comment: Element-mode job for uia_agent.py (the UIA controller). Copy to job.json,
edit, then run:  python uia_agent.py --job job.json --token <SHARED_TOKEN>
Each 'host' here is the LABEL a helper reports, NOT an address. On each VM:
The controller matches a dialed-in helper to the host with the same label,
runs every action on it, and drives all connected hosts in parallel.
username/password are the in-session login the model may type with
set_secret (Outlook, a portal). The model sees only 'login.username' /
'login.password', never the value. Use "secrets": [] on steps that must
never type the password. A lone backslash in a domain name must be doubled:

actions.do: If a Windows Activation or 'Set Network Location' dialog is on screen, dismiss it (Ask me later / Close). Stop when the desktop is clear.
Open Notepad and type: traffic-gen check OK. Stop when that text is visible in the editor.
Open Microsoft Edge and go to https://example.com. Stop when the page has loaded.
Open Outlook. If it asks to sign in, use the saved login. Stop when the inbox is on screen.
